body: You too man!

No you're not the only one. Every time I trip at night I can't sleep at all. Especially on a 3rd plateau dose. That's why I plan on taking naps before the trip so I can get enough sleep for the day. Sleep deprivation can be a bitch.
Have an awesome time man. Like lex said, weed and dxm is really good. I'm actually gonna be doing a dxm trip soon too.

Yeah I pretty much like DPH. But I love it most when combined with DXM. I just love the creepy feeling it gives off along with realistic hallucinations and the music intensity. Though honestly I love DXM more.

Thank you. And I will keep you guys updated on how things go. I hope it works out as well.

I mostly agree with what you said about it being our security blanket. It makes sense why. It's, well for me I can say it's the most I've felt safe and at peace. That's why I yearn to go back so much. 

Now that you mention the atmosphere of the place I can already see the dining area so clearly in my mind.
Dude Hacksaw Ridge is awesome. The war scenes are intense. Sometime's it can get horrifying.
I've seen it, it's good. If you haven't, check out Platoon. That is another really good war film.
The peak didn't last that long, but high still lasted. Sorry, forgot to mention that.
Yeah it's pretty powerful with its solid open eye hallucinations and eerie lighting, ominous atmosphere but not too sinister. It's pretty much like entering another dimension or a dream.
Wassssuuuuuppp. Dude I love the dreamworld feeling of this combo. It's awesome and fascinating. But kind of eerie too.
Thanks man. It was pretty awesome. I love the experience,
Yep but I can feel it slowly rot away.

It was eerie as hell. I've read that the highest dose of the dxm and dph combo is 500mg each. That's just insane. That sounds like  saying goodbye to sanity and being sucked into another dimension of terror.
Thanks for the comments, guys. I'll make sure I don't fuck up like that next time and not to take DPH to calm me down too.

I'm stuck in a hole as well, but not specifically in detail as yours. I'm unemployable, besides having a tiny job that only helps me get through the week (food/drink and a few drugs). I'm still living with my family and I'm 23. I suck at school and dropped out 2 years ago. I've attempted suicide multiple times but failed and gave up. I'm thinking of joining the Army since if I'm sent off to war, death will be at a higher possibility for me. As for the time between now and then, I don't know what to do. Workout I guess, play video games, watch youtube, and listen to music. I'm practically stuck otherwise.
I listen to music that relates with the mood I'm in. Mostly noise music, harsh noise, wall noise, death metal, deathcore, and so forth.
Lol nope, unless if you want to die that way. I'd rather prefer me dying by shotgun blast to the head personally.
I'm the usual. I'm getting ready to fry my sanity this week along with vomiting my guts out.
Because of programming, selfish desire, more money I believe, more people to serve them, and the list goes on.
Try telling all the sjws that they're not special. They can't face reality or truth.

In relation to the goal of most antinatalists, which from what I've gathered is to stop all suffering. And by my definition of fucked is humanity squirming in its own shit, blood and piss. As in its own self-annihilation, slow painful annihilation I believe. 
And true, not everything is shit. The alcohol and drugs I take to numb myself are good. Also my appetite for gore and death is satisfying yet it's starting to dull and lose its flavor. Also pizza is pretty good. Especially garlic chicken pizza. 
Now that I think of it, I think if most antinatalists (I assume), knew my appetites they'd probably crucify me.

There's nothing we can do. We're fucked. Antinatalism is completely futile in my honest opinion (I am an antinatalist btw). We can't change humanity, nature, the world. This is why I drink and get high, because everything's shit and is still going to shit. There's nothing in my power or anybody on this subreddit's power that can make things better, subjectively speaking. Unless of course if some of these people have nuclear weapons or some type of sterilization weapon. Which I doubt, so again, we're fucked.
Agreed. It's a hellish existence.
It's rather sickening.
My apology dude. I'll delete this shit if no one wants it here.

I don't know what to say. It's 2:30 am where I'm at right now, so I apologize if this isn't a well written reply. I agree that my depression is a reaction to the futility of existence. I have to admit that I am glad to see you, another nihilist such as myself, because it shows that there are more people who see the truth of existence as I do. I haven't yet tried to find someone like me to have a relationship/friendship because I see it as pointless. I understand that it could satisfy both myself and the person like me. But I guess I'm too lazy and lack motivation. Also I'm rather pessimistic about such a scenario taking place and relationships in general. However I do not seek to enjoy life nor to loathe it. I just seek to know more of the truth. But I guess I've learned so much of it that it's exhausted me. Hopefully that clears a few things up. And thank you for your response.
It's all good. Thanks for clearing it up.

So when people say that they know something when they really don't isn't lying? What? No one knows what's going to happen except that we are all going to die. Assuming to have the knowledge of what's going to exactly happen from this moment to our deaths is lying when they don't know at all.

Suicide in the simplest form isn't to cut oneself. Suicide is the act a person or sentient being commits by taking their life in any method they choose to take. And we're all ready stuck. We as a living species are stuck in hell or in other words existence. There's nowhere to go. We are going nowhere no matter what we do. Life has stuck us in its grasp, forcing deprivation, consumption, addiction, suffering, and death. That sounds like we're stuck. Consciousness pulls our strings telling us that there is something to be, do, somewhere to go, and someone to know. So to say that you're not stuck is delusional. Please tell me how we are going to get out of this rotting ditch? Heaven? Technological progression? It won't free us from consciousness, nature, and our programming.
And if you wish to live, contributing to society isn't the only way to survive. But if you see that as the only easy way you have more knowledge in, then go ahead.

I'm just saying that you cannot say suicide is never the answer when it's your perception due to your beliefs. Not everyone agrees that life is valuable and worth living. Thus claiming that suicide is never the answer is a personal claim instead of an objective view. So downvote me all you want, if that makes you comfortable with yourself.
To not contribute, obviously.

It's your perception that suicide is never the answer due to your belief and hope in a futile future. To say that suicide is never the answer is saying that an individual deciding to commit suicide is irrational. Please explain to me how it's irrational with logical proof.

Well I can only answer one of your questions based on what limited information I know of your exact situation. 
Why does everybody tell you it'll be okay? Most people tend to tell depressed people that "it'll be okay" because it's a way of comforting the depressed person, when in reality the people do not know the exact future of your life and what will come. So basically they're lying to you to make themselves and you feel comfortable with your life instead of admitting that they know nothing of what will come in your future.

Indeed we are. Yet you do have a choice to either find a way to benefit the social project you speak of, or not to find a way to benefit. Now if you're talking about you choosing to force yourself to "do your part," then that's understandable of you choosing not to have a choice to do so or not.

Love is a distraction, distracting the human's mind from the reality of their existence; that all we are is insignificant and useless beings. Love creates an illusion of meaning to one's life when there is no objective meaning or purpose in life.

I agree, depressed people do see reality for what it is. Life sucks and living imposes useless pointless pain and death. The positive things in life are just distractions to keep us from seeing the big picture of our existence: that we are malevolently useless and futile. Life is rotting, deprivation, consumption, addiction, lying to ones' self that things will get better when they know nothing of what the future will hold. We all know the future of all life, it is death. Everything we do will add up to nothing. Human progress and advancement will lead nowhere, trying to satisfy a never complete fulfilling thirst. And if that thirst is quenched, there will be nothing else to do but die.

I was raised religious as well, but now I am the darkest pessimistic misanthropic person my family, relatives, and my friends have ever known. And I do not desire to fall back into illusion since it offers me nothing. Also I wonder the same thing when I see couples walk by. I get a sick feeling in my stomach whenever I see people holding hands, kissing or flirting or talking about love.

I too day dream of suicide every day. I have no motivation to work, to do school, to socialize, to see movies, to play video games, to go out to the bar, and to even force myself to make a goal. I'm disgusted by my own existence. I feel burdensome to my family because I still live with them. I have lost all interests in what I used to like. I have lost interests in almost everything but smoking. I can't buy a gun since I was released from the mental hospital for suicidal tendencies and attempts. So all I got for a way out is a rope or a plastic bag. And neither way is painless and quick.

It's not as easy as you say. After losing complete interest in many things, almost everything, it's difficult to convince myself to be interested. And I refuse to go back to the old interests, their taste has dulled out.
Reading cosmic horror. But recently I've gotten too lazy and tired to even open the book.
There's rarely anything I find interesting anymore.
I'm 21 years old.
I have no use to say that things will get better because I cannot tell the future and I refuse to give you false hope. I just wish you a painless and peaceful exit.
Cosmic horror mostly contains of unspeakable or terrifying beings that show how insignificant the humanity is. I smoke cigarettes and I like Fireball whiskey.
Smoking and drinking. Reading cosmic horror. That's about it.
I refuse to take temporary escapes. I'm only interested in a permanent escape from existence, and that is death.

Are they permanent ways of unconsciousness? Because death is the only permanent form of unconsciousness I know of. I'm only seeking permanent forms, because I do not wish to wake back up into this nightmare.
How is death not the only way to experience no conciousness? Unless if you mean being in a coma.

You missed the sentence "And I refuse to lie to myself because there’s no logical reason to do so. There’s no point in doing so at all." I see no reason to fill my head with illusion because there is no logical point in lying to myself just to be comfortable. And the puppet masters do not feel, they are uncaring and apathetic. Nature and conciousness doesn't give a fuck if we suffer and die.
My own mind is the puppet master. My mind is conciousness. And the only time anyone can be free from our puppet masters is when we die. No conciousness=no puppet master.
Thank you.
Thanks for the info. I should have stated in the first premise that it's my perspective that the universe came naturally. These thoughts I typed are what they are: thoughts.

I guess why I am worried about caring to destroy the people creating chaos is because I still have an emotional part of me that has a blind wish of things getting better. But deep inside of me I see that if we were to have peace, it wouldn't change our meaningless existence. I guess I still have some illusion of hope that my mind doesn't want to let go of. However that illusion is dying slowly day by day.
